name: Virtual Magic Window
definition: A restricted case of the VML where the virtual lantern illuminates following the viewing direction. The region of interest is the intersection of the virtual lantern (guided by the pointer) and the bounding box of the volume, effectively creating a 'window' through which the volume is seen with a secondary style.
summary: The Virtual Magic Window is a volume rendering metaphor that displays a specific region of interest through a virtual window while rendering the rest of the volume differently, incurring no performance penalty.
